name: Godly Women
overview: Scripture reveals that Godly women are uniquely created to be a fitting helper for man, as established from the beginning in Genesis 2:18. Proverbs 31 highlights the value and character of such women, describing them as virtuous, clothed with strength and honor, and wise in speech. True beauty and favor are found not in outward appearance but in a reverent fear of the Lord, which brings lasting praise and joy.
